name: Ava Capital Plc
source: AVA Capital Plc unaudited report for the period ended 30 June 2026, consolidated statements of financial position and of cash flow, filed through the Nigerian Exchange disclosure library. The filing prints N thousands; stored here in absolute Naira.
note: Group column of the consolidated statement of financial position as filed, unaudited, 30 June 2026 against 31 December 2025. Total Assets agrees with the printed Total Liabilities and Equities line of 110,957,143 and the printed components Total Liabilities 98,229,262 plus Total Equity 12,727,880 sum to 110,957,142, a difference of N1 thousand which is inside the filing own rounding at its printed N thousands scale; the December 2025 column ties exactly at 19,140,049. Non-current and current sub-totals are withheld because the issuer presents assets in liquidity order with no current or non-current split.
